test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 10 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is INCORRECT?

options.text: Vint Cerf is recognised as one of the ‘Fathers of the Internet’.
In internet terminology, IP means Internet Practice.
The first computer in India was installed in the Indian Statistical Institute, Kolkata.
Hotmail is the first free web-based email service introduced in 1995.

solution:
The correct answer is__** ​In internet terminology, IP means Internet Practice.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• In Internet Terminology, IP means** Internet Protocol.**
 
• **The Internet Protocol (IP)** is a set of requirements for addressing
